summary: Provides low-level control over POP point counts, topology, vertices, primitives, and memory allocation. It can build topology from unsigned point-index attributes, from another POP, from manual topology info, or from GPU-resident count attributes.

key_params.name: maxpointsmode
key_params.note: How maximum point allocation is determined

key_params.name: primsourcemode
key_params.note: Use input primitive source or specified POP

key_params.name: primmode
key_params.note: Source topology or attribute/manual topology info

key_params.name: pointindexattrname
key_params.note: Unsigned point-index attribute used to describe topology

key_concepts: POP point count and topology allocation
manual Topology Info versus GPU attribute counts
primitive, vertex, and primitive-attribute source POPs
GLSL Advanced POP topology buffer handoff
common_gotchas: Topology POP is for advanced/generated buffers; it can create invalid geometry if counts and index attributes disagree.
Disable render while intermediate topology is incomplete or non-renderable.
Manual count info can avoid GPU-to-CPU stalls, but only when exact counts are truly known.
